name: build-arg-no-ledger
description: With no ledger there is nothing to correct, so the argument is rejected before pre-flight and before `init`: no ledger is created to hold it, no code is written, and the change routes to `mano start` for a fresh scope approval. Run in auto so the refusal cannot quietly consume the standing approval and build anyway.
prompt: mano-build "also add a debug stage module that prints load timings"
